from scipy.optimize import minimize
verts09=np.array(byname['M09']['vertices']); verts03=np.array(byname['M03']['vertices'])
best=None
for face09,indices09 in enumerate(byname['M09']['triangles']):
 triangle09=verts09[indices09]
 for face03,indices03 in enumerate(byname['M03']['triangles']):
  triangle03=verts03[indices03]
  origin=triangle09[0]-triangle03[0]
  basis=np.column_stack((triangle09[1]-triangle09[0],triangle09[2]-triangle09[0],-(triangle03[1]-triangle03[0]),-(triangle03[2]-triangle03[0])))
  result=minimize(lambda weights: np.sum((origin+basis@weights)**2),np.full(4,1/3),jac=lambda weights:2*basis.T@(origin+basis@weights),bounds=[(0,1)]*4,constraints=[{'type':'ineq','fun':lambda weights:1-weights[0]-weights[1]},{'type':'ineq','fun':lambda weights:1-weights[2]-weights[3]}],method='SLSQP',options={'ftol':1e-14,'maxiter':500})
  if not result.success: print('FAIL',face09,face03,result.message)
  point09=triangle09[0]+result.x[0]*(triangle09[1]-triangle09[0])+result.x[1]*(triangle09[2]-triangle09[0])
  point03=triangle03[0]+result.x[2]*(triangle03[1]-triangle03[0])+result.x[3]*(triangle03[2]-triangle03[0])
  distance=np.linalg.norm(point03-point09)
  if best is None or distance<best[0]:best=(distance,face09,face03,point09,point03)
print('all 28 triangle pairs checked:',best)
print('unit direction',(best[4]-best[3])/best[0])
